name: Decoupled Toolbox for Comment Field
description: Makes Comment compatible with Decoupled Toolbox.
project_description: Decoupled Toolbox for Comment Field is a sub-module of Decoupled Toolbox. Makes Comment compatible with Decoupled Toolbox. It ships a single decoupled field formatter (plugin `decoupled_comment_field`, class `CommentFieldDecoupledFormatter`) so that comment fields can be placed on the Decoupled view mode and serialized to JSON by the parent module's collection endpoint. Uses the PHP-attribute plugin form `#[FieldFormatter(id: 'decoupled_comment_field', ...)]` and extends `GenericDecoupledFormatter`.
